AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential performance degradation.
Evaluate AI system's configuration and ensure it is properly integrated and operational.
Review and potentially adjust trading strategies to ensure they are actively engaging in trades.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve the cause.
recommendations.rationale: Sustained high CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting user experience and platform reliability.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to ensure it is functioning correctly and contributing to trading decisions.
